# Interface and custom-section vectors (chain ABI 4.1, 3.4).
#
# One vector per line: <kind> <expected> <input> [# note]
#   kind      what the input is: "interface" (the bytes of an `abi.interface`
#             section) or "custom-sections" (the names of a module's custom
#             sections in order, each as a u8 length and the name's bytes)
#   expected  "ok", or the reason the input is rejected
#   input     the bytes, in hex after "0x"

# Interfaces: accepted. Each must also encode back to the same bytes.
interface ok 0x0000000100000000000000000000000000000000  # version 1, nothing declared
interface ok 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000  # any version decodes; matching the import module is a separate rule
interface ok 0xffffffff00000000000000000000000000000000
interface ok 0x00000001000000020b6765742d62616c616e636501087472616e7366657200000000000000000000000000  # a read-only and a public function
interface ok 0x00000001000000030b6765742d62616c616e636501056d696e742100087472616e7366657200000000020b7374782d7772617070656405746f6b656e00000001046465656400000003046275726e046d696e74087472616e73666572  # functions, tokens and events
interface ok 0x0000000100000001016100000000010161000000010161000000010161  # a name is unique within its list only
interface ok 0x000000010000000601410001420001610002612d0002616100016200000000000000000000000000  # byte order: uppercase first, a prefix before its extensions
interface ok   # a name of 128 bytes, the longest
interface ok 0x00000001000000000000000a012a012b012d012f013c013d013e013f015e015f0000000000000000  # names of one symbol, in byte order

# Interfaces: the bytes end early.
interface truncated 0x  # no bytes
interface truncated 0x000000  # three bytes of the version
interface truncated 0x00000001  # no function count
interface truncated 0x000000010000  # half a count
interface truncated 0x0000000100000001  # one function declared, none present
interface truncated 0x0000000100000001036162  # name length 3, 2 bytes
interface truncated 0x0000000100000001026162  # no kind byte
interface truncated 0x0000000100000000  # no token count
interface truncated 0x00000001000000000000000000000000  # no event count
interface truncated 0x00000001000000000000000000000000000000  # three bytes of the event count
interface truncated 0x0000000100000000000000020161  # two tokens declared, one present
interface truncated 0x00000001ffffffff  # a count of 2^32 - 1 and nothing after it
interface truncated 0x0000000100000001016100ffffffff0161  # a count far past the end

# Interfaces: a name is not valid (2.1).
interface name-empty 0x00000001000000010000000000000000000000000000  # function
interface name-empty 0x000000010000000000000000000000000000000100  # event
interface name-too-long   # 129 bytes
interface name-too-long 0x0000000100000001ff  # the length byte alone decides, before the bytes are read
interface name-bad-byte 0x00000001000000010361206200000000000000000000000000  # space
interface name-bad-byte 0x00000001000000000000000102c3a90000000000000000  # not ASCII
interface name-bad-byte 0x0000000100000000000000000000000103612e6200000000
interface name-bad-start 0x00000001000000010331737400000000000000000000000000  # starts with a digit
interface name-bad-start 0x0000000100000000000000000000000000000001022d31  # starts like a number
interface name-bad-start 0x0000000100000000000000010275310000000000000000

# Interfaces: a list is not in strictly ascending order.
interface unsorted 0x0000000100000002016200016100000000000000000000000000  # functions
interface unsorted 0x000000010000000000000002016201610000000000000000  # fungible tokens
interface unsorted 0x000000010000000000000000000000020162016100000000  # non-fungible tokens
interface unsorted 0x000000010000000000000000000000000000000201620161  # events
interface unsorted 0x0000000100000002016100014200000000000000000000000000  # byte order, not alphabetical
interface unsorted 0x000000010000000202616100016100000000000000000000000000  # an extension before its prefix
interface unsorted 0x0000000100000003016100016300016200000000000000000000000000  # the last name
interface duplicate 0x0000000100000002016100016100000000000000000000000000  # functions
interface duplicate 0x0000000100000002016100016101000000000000000000000000  # the same name with another kind
interface duplicate 0x000000010000000000000002016101610000000000000000
interface duplicate 0x000000010000000000000000000000020161016100000000
interface duplicate 0x000000010000000000000000000000000000000201610161

# Interfaces: a kind byte is neither 0 nor 1.
interface bad-kind 0x0000000100000001016102000000000000000000000000
interface bad-kind 0x00000001000000010161ff000000000000000000000000
interface bad-kind 0x0000000100000002016100016202000000000000000000000000  # the second function

# Interfaces: the first invalid field decides.
interface unsorted 0x0000000100000002016200016102000000000000000000000000  # order is judged before the kind byte
interface name-bad-byte 0x00000001000000020162000361206200000000000000000000000000  # a name is checked before its place in the list
interface bad-kind 0x000000010000000101610200000000000000000000000000  # a bad kind before trailing bytes

# Interfaces: bytes follow the encoding.
interface trailing-bytes 0x000000010000000000000000000000000000000000
interface trailing-bytes 0x00000001000000030b6765742d62616c616e636501056d696e742100087472616e7366657200000000020b7374782d7772617070656405746f6b656e00000001046465656400000003046275726e046d696e74087472616e7366657200000000  # a fifth list
interface trailing-bytes   # two interfaces

# Custom sections: accepted.
custom-sections ok 0x0d6162692e696e74657266616365  # the interface alone
custom-sections ok 0x0d6162692e696e74657266616365096162692e7479706573
custom-sections ok 0x0d6162692e696e746572666163650e6162692e70726f76656e616e6365
custom-sections ok 0x0d6162692e696e74657266616365096162692e74797065730e6162692e70726f76656e616e6365  # all three
custom-sections ok 0x0e6162692e70726f76656e616e6365096162692e74797065730d6162692e696e74657266616365  # in any order

# Custom sections: a section the ABI does not allow.
custom-sections unknown 0x0d6162692e696e74657266616365046e616d65  # the name section
custom-sections unknown 0x046e616d650d6162692e696e74657266616365
custom-sections unknown 0x0d6162692e696e746572666163650970726f647563657273
custom-sections unknown 0x0d6162692e696e7465726661636500  # an empty name
custom-sections unknown 0x0d6162692e696e746572666163650e6162692e696e7465726661636573
custom-sections unknown 0x0d6162692e696e74657266616365094142492e7479706573  # names are compared byte for byte
custom-sections unknown 0x0d6162692e696e74657266616365096162692e6f74686572
custom-sections unknown 0x046e616d65  # an unknown section is judged before the missing interface

# Custom sections: a section appears twice.
custom-sections duplicate 0x0d6162692e696e746572666163650d6162692e696e74657266616365
custom-sections duplicate 0x0d6162692e696e74657266616365096162692e7479706573096162692e7479706573
custom-sections duplicate 0x0d6162692e696e746572666163650e6162692e70726f76656e616e6365096162692e74797065730e6162692e70726f76656e616e6365
custom-sections duplicate 0x096162692e7479706573096162692e7479706573  # a duplicate is judged before the missing interface

# Custom sections: the first section that breaks a rule decides.
custom-sections unknown 0x046e616d65096162692e7479706573096162692e7479706573  # name, then abi.types twice
custom-sections duplicate 0x096162692e7479706573096162692e7479706573046e616d65  # abi.types twice, then name

# Custom sections: no interface.
custom-sections missing-interface 0x  # no custom sections
custom-sections missing-interface 0x096162692e7479706573
custom-sections missing-interface 0x096162692e74797065730e6162692e70726f76656e616e6365
